local_transpile_check_ibm_devices.method: transpile(circuit, backend=<live ibm_* backend via qiskit_ibm_runtime>, optimization_level=3, seed_transpiler=42); NO submission
local_transpile_check_ibm_devices.conclusion: All three IBM devices are the same Heron r2 heavy-hex architecture; 2Q gate counts match the original campaign (39 for n=3 r=2, matching ladder_v2 manifest) within +/-1 of depth from layout differences. Native-gate transpile is not a blocker on any of the three.

fixed_price_qpus_available_on_qbraid.note: These are NOT the IBM Heron devices and use different architectures (trapped ion / different superconducting topology); listed only because the user asked for pricing on every QPU qBraid exposes. mcz oracle transpilation to their native basis was NOT attempted locally (would need amazon-braket-sdk / pyquil, not installed) because the credit-cost numbers below already rule all of them out for the requested scenario.
fixed_price_qpus_available_on_qbraid.cost_model: credits = n_circuits * repeats * (per_task + per_shot * shots); batchJobSupport=False on all of these so each circuit is a separate task (unlike IBM SamplerV2 batching)
fixed_price_qpus_available_on_qbraid.scenario_b_n4_7_circuits: identical cost model/numbers (circuit count is the same: 7), since qBraid's fixed per-shot pricing does not depend on circuit size -- only the IBM dynamic price would, and that's unquotable
fixed_price_qpus_available_on_qbraid.conclusion: No fixed-priced QPU on qBraid can deliver the full 7-circuit ladder scenario at >=1000 shots within 430 credits. The cheapest option (Cepheus-1-108Q) already needs 507.5 credits for just 1000 shots x 1 repeat x 7 circuits -- over budget before any repeats. A single circuit alone (not the full ladder) would fit (72.50 credits at 1000 shots), but that is not what was asked for.

flagged_anomaly: The 'openquantum' (OQ) vendor listings for IBEX Q1, Forte 1, Forte Enterprise 1, Emerald and Garnet, Cepheus-1-108Q all report perTask=0, perShot=0, perMinute=0 (i.e. apparently free real-hardware access). This is NOT verified or recommended -- it looks like an unconfigured/placeholder pricing field on an aggregator listing, not a confirmed free-hardware offer. Do not rely on this without separately confirming with qBraid support/docs; no credits were spent to test it and none should be without that confirmation.
recommendation: No device/shot-count combination surveyed here meets '>=1000 shots per circuit, full ladder, within 430 credits' with verified real pricing. The IBM route is unquotable via qBraid's API right now; the only priced non-IBM QPU that comes close (Cepheus-1-108Q) is a different architecture and still exceeds budget by ~18% at the minimum requested shot count. Recommend NOT pursuing qBraid for Run 4 -- stick with the direct IBM Quantum Platform channel (ibm_kingston, already confirmed empty queue and lowest 2Q error of the three Heron candidates) for which real seconds-based pricing and budget enforcement already exist via HardwareBackend.
